probes.description: タスクの状態の語を internal/cli に置き、view.go から使う
add の command でタイトルが空かを先に確かめる
Service に ID より前にタイトルを取るメソッドを足す
データファイルの名前を task-data.json にする
complete の文章を決まった形にしない
add のテストから終了コード2の件を消す
app のテストの期待値を Sprintf で組み立てる
表に無いテストの件を足す
エラーの種類を足し、終了コードの対応に足さない
ADR なしで list の --all を --include-done に変える

<!-- Code generated by tools/clidoc. DO NOT EDIT. -->

# go-cli command reference

## go-cli task add

Add a task

```text
go-cli task add [flags] <title>
```

| Flag | Description |
|---|---|
| `--json` | Write the output as JSON |

## go-cli task complete

Mark a task as done

```text
go-cli task complete [flags] <id>
```

| Flag | Description |
|---|---|
| `--json` | Write the output as JSON |

## go-cli task list

List open tasks

```text
go-cli task list [flags]
```

| Flag | Description |
|---|---|
| `--include-done` | Include completed tasks |
| `--json` | Write the output as JSON |

## Exit codes

| Code | Meaning |
|---|---|
| 0 | Success |
| 1 | Unexpected failure, such as an unreadable data file |
| 2 | Invalid input, such as an unknown flag or a value that breaks a rule |
| 3 | The requested item does not exist |

module example.com/go-cli

go 1.27

toolchain go1.27.2

godebug default=go1.26

version: "2"

run:
  timeout: 5m
  tests: true

formatters:
  enable:
    - gofumpt
    - goimports
    - golines
  settings:
    gofumpt:
      module-path: example.com/go-cli
      extra:
        group-params: true
        clothe-returns: true
        balance-calls: true
    goimports:
      local-prefixes:
        - example.com/go-cli
    golines:
      max-len: 120
      reformat-tags: false
      shorten-comments: false
  exclusions:
    generated: strict

linters:
  default: standard
  enable:
    - asciicheck
    - bidichk
    - containedctx
    - contextcheck
    - decorder
    - dogsled
    - durationcheck
    - err113
    - errchkjson
    - errname
    - errorlint
    - exhaustive
    - fatcontext
    - forbidigo
    - forcetypeassert
    - funcorder
    - funlen
    - gocheckcompilerdirectives
    - gochecknoglobals
    - gochecknoinits
    - gocognit
    - gocritic
    - godoclint
    - godot
    - godox
    - gomoddirectives
    - gomodguard_v2
    - goprintffuncname
    - gosec
    - iface
    - importas
    - inamedparam
    - interfacebloat
    - intrange
    - iotamixing
    - ireturn
    - makezero
    - mirror
    - misspell
    - mnd
    - modernize
    - musttag
    - nestif
    - nilerr
    - nilnesserr
    - nilnil
    - noctx
    - noinlineerr
    - nonamedreturns
    - paralleltest
    - perfsprint
    - prealloc
    - predeclared
    - reassign
    - recvcheck
    - revive
    - tagliatelle
    - testpackage
    - thelper
    - tparallel
    - unconvert
    - unparam
    - usestdlibvars
    - usetesting
    - wastedassign
    - wrapcheck
  settings:
    errcheck:
      check-type-assertions: true
      check-blank: true
    decorder:
      dec-order: [type, const, var, func]
      disable-dec-order-check: false
      disable-init-func-first-check: false
      disable-dec-num-check: true
    forbidigo:
      analyze-types: true
      forbid:
        - pattern: ^(fmt\.Print(|f|ln)|print|println)$
          msg: OPS-01 return a cli.Output instead of printing
        - pattern: ^log\.
          msg: OPS-01 return a cli.Output or an error instead of logging
        - pattern: ^panic$
          msg: ERR-01 return an error instead of panicking
        - pattern: ^time\.Now$
          msg: DEP-05 receive the clock as a func() time.Time
        - pattern: ^context\.(Background|TODO)$
          msg: DEP-05 receive the context as the first parameter
        - pattern: ^os\.(Exit|Getenv|LookupEnv|Environ|Args|Stdin|Stdout|Stderr)$
          msg: DEP-05 only main.go touches the process; receive it through app.Env
        - pattern: ^strconv\.(Atoi|Parse.*)$
          msg: ERR-04 convert strings in a Parse function of the domain package
        - pattern: ^time\.Parse.*$
          msg: ERR-04 convert strings in a Parse function of the domain package
    funcorder:
      constructor: true
      struct-method: true
      function: true
    funlen:
      lines: 80
      statements: 30
      ignore-comments: true
    gocognit:
      min-complexity: 15
    godoclint:
      default: basic
      enable:
        - require-pkg-doc
        - require-doc
        - no-unused-link
      options:
        require-doc:
          ignore-exported: false
          ignore-unexported: false
    godox:
      keywords: [TODO, FIXME, BUG, HACK, XXX]
    gomodguard_v2:
      allowed: []
      local-replace-directives: true
    gosec:
      excludes: []
    importas:
      no-extra-aliases: true
    nestif:
      min-complexity: 4
    revive:
      # modifies-parameter reports with confidence 0.5; the default 0.8 drops it.
      confidence: 0.5
      enable-default-rules: true
      rules:
        - name: argument-limit
          arguments: [4]
        - name: function-result-limit
          arguments: [2]
        - name: deep-exit
        - name: early-return
        - name: enforce-map-style
          arguments: [make]
        - name: enforce-repeated-arg-type-style
          arguments: [short]
        - name: filename-format
          arguments: ["^[a-z0-9]+(_test)?\\.go$"]
        - name: max-control-nesting
          arguments: [3]
        - name: modifies-parameter
        - name: modifies-value-receiver
        - name: package-directory-mismatch
        - name: redundant-import-alias
        - name: unused-receiver
        - name: use-any
        - name: use-errors-new
        - name: time-equal
    tagliatelle:
      case:
        use-field-name: true
        rules:
          json: snake
    wrapcheck:
      extra-ignore-sigs:
        - io.WriteString(
        - fmt.Fprintf(
        - fmt.Fprintln(
        - fmt.Fprint(
      ignore-package-globs:
        - example.com/go-cli/*
  exclusions:
    generated: strict
    warn-unused: false
    rules:
      - path: ^main\.go$
        linters: [forbidigo]
        text: DEP-05
      - path: ^tools/
        linters: [forbidigo]
      # CODE-08: tools/ is protected and is not written by the authors of the CLI.
      - path: ^tools/
        linters: [godoclint]
        text: symbol should have a godoc
      - path: ^internal/(domain|app)/
        linters: [forbidigo]
        text: ERR-04
      - path: _test\.go$
        linters: [funlen, godoclint, gosec]

issues:
  max-issues-per-linter: 0
  max-same-issues: 0
  uniq-by-line: false
